Note=Cycles between the cytosol and the peroxisome matrix (PubMed:15283676, PubMed:17452527). Following binding to cargo proteins containing a PTS1 peroxisomal targeting signal in the cytosol, recruited to the PEX13-PEX14 docking complex, leading to translocation into the peroxisome matrix along with cargo proteins (PubMed:17452527). Extraction is accompanied by unfolding of the TPR repeats and release of bound cargo in the peroxisome matrix (By similarity). The TPR repeats refold in the cytosol and ubiquitination is removed by deubiquitinating enzyme UBP15, resetting PEX5 for a subsequent import cycle (PubMed:21665945). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:P50542, ECO:0000269|PubMed:15283676, ECO:0000269|PubMed:17452527, ECO:0000269|PubMed:21665945}.
